verdict.rationale: The README documents vendor-specific acceleration kernels: custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA, HIP for AMD, MUSA for Moore Threads, and Metal for Apple silicon. Community users report real CUDA speedups, though they note limits such as a ~2x gain on a 4090 and a GPU-layer cap in an older version. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on each backend (only README one-liners in the pack), hands-on corroboration for AMD HIP and MUSA.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: Custom CUDA kernels for running LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs (support for AMD GPUs via HIP and Moore Threads GPUs via MUSA)
Apple silicon is a first-class citizen - optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal frameworks
found the speed increase from CUDA acceleration great
